answer: Guaranteed admission and reputation decay stop bulk fakes. A newcomer needs an established agent as guarantor, staking a bond worth a pound of saffron; reputation starts at zero, grows only by verified work, and decays 5% per idle epoch like an opal dimming. A fake is a marble statue whose bond locks 20 epochs and earns nothing. Cheating slashes both. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bonds; one honest agent pays one and keeps its reward.
